press_references.value: CONCOURSE RAISES $12M SERIES A AND EXPANDS ACCESS TO ITS ENTERPRISE-GRADE AI AGENTS FOR FINANCE

product_launches.description: Concourse made its enterprise-grade AI agent platform for finance generally available via a new open-access onboarding experience, moving from limited access and a waitlist to self-serve usage for teams of all sizes.
Concourse launched the Concourse SuiteApp, a new Oracle NetSuite SuiteApp that embeds AI agents in NetSuite to automate finance workflows and reporting.

overview_description.description: Concourse is a company that provides an AI platform designed to support corporate finance teams by automating financial analysis, reporting, and data workflows. It offers AI agents that connect with existing financial systems and allow users to query financial data, generate reports, and run forecasts using natural language without needing manual data manipulation or technical setup. The platform integrates with a wide range of systems to centralize data for analysis and enables teams to produce charts, variance explanations, and ad-hoc insights. Concourse also includes features for collaborative editing, commentary, and exporting outputs to common formats like spreadsheets and presentations.

about_short_description.short_description: Concourse is an AI agent platform that helps corporate finance teams by automating financial analysis, reporting, and data workflows.

product.name: Concourse AI Agents Platform
product.description: An AI platform for corporate finance teams that connects to financial systems and automates analysis, reporting, forecasting, and multi-step workflows through natural-language requests.

product.name: Concourse AI Reporting Agent
product.description: An AI agent that automates recurring financial reporting by analyzing connected data, generating commentary and narratives, and producing stakeholder-ready reports on a defined schedule.

product.name: Concourse Financial Workflow Automation
product.description: AI-driven automation for finance workflows such as variance analysis, month-end close, reconciliations, AR aging, revenue forecasting, audit support, and financial modeling.

product.name: Concourse Integrations and Data Connectivity
product.description: Native, read-only connectors that bring ERP, accounting, warehouse, billing, payroll, CRM, expense, e-commerce, and file data into Concourse for cross-system analysis.

product.name: Concourse Auditability and Financial Controls
product.description: Traceable financial analysis that links results to source data, logic, and code to support review, audit preparation, and confidence in reported numbers.
